message.text:
*Live test: which cluster should I look at first?* 2 candidates

Both run *checkout-gateway*; only one is in `us-central1`.

- `major` `kube-agents-cluster` restarts every 10 minutes
  OOMKilled, exit 137
- `platform-agent-host` is healthy

*why*
Each cluster's last restart, as `kubectl` reported it.
```
cluster             | restarts | last
--------------------+----------+--------
kube-agents-cluster | 6        | 10m ago
platform-agent-host | 0        | never
```
